data.body_html:
Choosing between the Azimut 39 vs Pershing 46 for your Marbella yacht charter? Both are excellent vessels departing from Puerto Banús, but they cater to different priorities: budget vs performance, passenger capacity vs sporty style. This side-by-side comparison breaks down length, pax limits, cost, and onboard experience so you can decide which boat fits your day on the Costa del Sol.

Azimut 39 Overview

The Azimut 39 is a 12.5-metre motor yacht accommodating up to 11 passengers. It’s one of our most popular all-inclusive charters, priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours — with skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT included. This makes it a cost-effective choice for groups wanting a full day of cruising along the Marbella coastline, from Puerto Banús to Cabopino or Estepona.

Pershing 46 Overview

The Pershing 46 measures 14 metres and carries up to 10 passengers. It’s a sportier, higher-performance yacht known for its sleek lines and faster cruising speeds. Pricing is available on request via WhatsApp — no fixed hourly rate — because every charter is customised. Expect a more premium feel, ideal for those who prioritise style and speed over maximum capacity.

Which Yacht Should You Choose?

If you’re watching your budget or have a group of 11 people, the Azimut 39 is the clear winner. Its all-inclusive pricing means no surprises — you pay one price for everything. It’s perfect for a relaxed day of swimming, sunbathing, and visiting coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

If you want a more exclusive, faster experience and don’t mind paying a premium, the Pershing 46 delivers. It’s better suited for couples or smaller groups (up to 10) who appreciate design and performance. Contact us for a quote and we’ll tailor the trip to your wishes, whether that’s a high-speed run to Sotogrande or a sunset cruise along the Golden Mile.

Where They Sail: Marbella & Beyond

Both yachts depart from Puerto Banús, giving you instant access to the best of the Costa del Sol. Popular routes include heading west to Cabopino or Estepona, east to Marbella Marina, or further afield to Sotogrande. The Azimut 39’s steady cruising makes it ideal for families, while the Pershing 46’s speed lets you cover more distance in less time.

What’s Included on Both Charters

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden extras. The only difference is the pricing model — Azimut 39 has fixed rates, Pershing 46 is on request.

How to Book

Ready to reserve? For the Azimut 39, you can book directly online with instant confirmation. For the Pershing 46, send us a WhatsApp message for a personalised quote. We’ll help you compare options and find the perfect yacht for your Marbella adventure.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the main difference between the Azimut 39 and Pershing 46?

The Azimut 39 is slightly shorter (12.5m vs 14m) but carries up to 11 passengers versus 10 on the Pershing 46. The Pershing 46 is a sportier, faster yacht with a more premium feel, while the Azimut 39 offers a more budget-friendly all-inclusive rate.

How much does it cost to charter the Azimut 39 in Marbella?

The Azimut 39 is priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. This includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%).

How much does it cost to charter the Pershing 46?

Pricing for the Pershing 46 is available on request via WhatsApp. It does not have a fixed hourly rate like the Azimut 39. Contact us for a custom quote tailored to your itinerary and duration.

Which yacht is better for a large group?

The Azimut 39 can accommodate up to 11 passengers, while the Pershing 46 holds 10. For the largest group possible, the Azimut 39 is the better option, especially at its competitive all-inclusive rate.

Which yacht is faster or more sporty?

The Pershing 46 is known for its sporty design and higher performance, making it a favourite for those who enjoy speed and a dynamic ride. The Azimut 39 is more of a comfortable cruiser, ideal for relaxing and socialising.

Do both yachts depart from Puerto Banús?

Yes, both the Azimut 39 and the Pershing 46 depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's famous marina. This gives you direct access to the Costa del Sol's best spots like Cabopino, Cala del Faro, and Estepona.

What is included on a Pershing 46 charter?

The Pershing 46 charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT. The only difference is pricing, which is on request rather than fixed.

Can I book the Azimut 39 or Pershing 46 for a half-day trip?

Yes. The Azimut 39 has a 2-hour option (€749) and full-day 8-hour option (€2,299). For the Pershing 46, you can request any duration via WhatsApp, and we will provide a custom quote.
